Item Description:
14+ Piece Collection of Fossils, Minerals, Crystals, Shells w/Beaded Trinket Box
A small rock, mineral, crystal, fossil, and shell collection consisting of :
1) 1.25" long piece of white selenite, rounded on the edges;
2) 2 pieces of brown aragonite crystal clusters, 1.5" and 2" long
3) a broken-open crystal quartz geode, 3" long, with vivid purple interior
4) 4 small pieces of green-blue copper bearing mineral such as azurite, malachite, or chrysocolla
5) a 1.5" x1" piece of quartz crystal tipped with yellow-orange brown, such as citrine quartz
6) A 1" wide blue grey agate geode
7) a 1" wide striped black white and grey agate geode
8) a beach-weathered spiral shell fragment, 4" long, grey and white
9) a chunk of white hardened coral, 4"x 3"
10) a 2" x 1" chunk of white brain coral
11) a 1.5" wide stripey agate geode in white, goldish tan and grey
12) a small gold velvet bag
13) a small cloth net champagne colored drawsring bag with a note about the mystical properties of silver topaz
14) a red hexagonal box , beaded with red and black, with inset v shaped or heart shaped mirror tiles and gold rim. 2.5"

277473300.description: This listing includes a vintage Sony Cassette-Corder model TCM-929 and three sealed Maxell UR 90 normal bias audio cassette tapes. The Sony TCM-929 is a portable cassette recorder and player made of black plastic. It features Full Auto Shut-Off and Cue & Review functions. The unit operates on 4 AA batteries (batteries not included). The cassette-corder shows visible wear consistent with light use but has no major damage. The Maxell UR 90 tapes are new and sealed, each providing 90 minutes (135 meters) of recording time. These tapes are suitable for voice, music, or general audio recording. This bundle is suitable for collectors, analog audio users, or those looking for a vintage cassette recording setup. Tested for basic functionality. Sold as-is. See photos.

The assortment includes various types of possibly other semi-precious stones. The stones vary in size from small fragments to larger chunks. All items are in raw, unprocessed condition, showing natural wear, dirt, and breakage typical of unprocessed mineral lots. Ideal for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or educational use. No specific brand or model is associated with this lot.
